cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过雷击吗？
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. No, I have never encountered a lightning strike during flight. But I know a lightning strike is dangerous, so pilots should avoid lightning strikes during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。不，我在飞行中从未遇到过雷击，但我知道雷击很危险，所以我们应该在飞行中避免雷击。

cards.audioText: In what kind of weather conditions is lightning strike most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的天气条件下最有可能发生雷击？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms and cumulonimbus clouds (CBs) with strong convective currents. They can also happen in snowstorms, dust storms, or near erupting volcanoes. Summer is the peak season due to unstable atmospheric conditions that cause charge imbalances in clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击最易发生在有强对流气流的雷暴和积雨云（CB）天气中，也可能出现在暴风雪、沙尘暴或火山喷发附近。夏季是高发季节，此时大气条件不稳定，易导致云层中电荷失衡。

cards.audioText: Why can a lightning strike threaten flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么雷击会威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike can damage the airframe, windshield, control surfaces, or electrical systems. It may also disrupt navigation and communication equipment, start an electrical fire, or injure people on board. The crew should avoid thunderstorms whenever possible and assess the aircraft carefully after any strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机体、风挡、操纵面或电气系统，也可能干扰导航和通信设备，引发电气火灾，或造成人员受伤。机组应尽可能避开雷暴，并在遭遇雷击后认真评估飞机状态。

cards.audioText: What would you do if your aircraft encountered a lightning strike in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机在飞行中遭遇雷击，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: I would first maintain aircraft control and follow the applicable checklist. I would assess the aircraft for structural or system damage, inform ATC, and request a deviation, diversion, or priority handling if necessary. After landing, I would record the event and arrange the required maintenance inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会首先保持对飞机的控制并执行适用的检查单，评估飞机是否存在结构或系统损伤，通知空中交通管制员，并在必要时申请偏航、备降或优先处置。着陆后，我会记录事件并安排所需的维修检查。

cards.audioText: What measures can pilots take to avoid lightning strikes?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以采取哪些措施避免雷击？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should review forecasts, reports, and airport weather before departure and continue monitoring weather during flight. They should use available weather radar and ATC information, avoid cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorms by a safe margin, and request an early deviation when hazardous weather is ahead. Delaying departure or diverting is appropriate when safe avoidance is not possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应在离场前检查天气预报、报告和机场天气，并在飞行中持续监控天气。机组应利用可用的气象雷达和空中交通管制信息，与积雨云和雷暴保持安全间隔，并在前方存在危险天气时尽早申请偏航。如果无法安全绕飞，延误起飞或备降是合适的选择。

cards.audioText: How can a lightning strike threaten flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击会如何威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike can cause structural damage, crack a windshield, damage control surfaces, or affect electrical, navigation, and communication systems. It may also produce an electrical fire or injure people on board. The severity varies, so the crew should assess the aircraft and follow the applicable procedure after a strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能造成结构损伤、风挡破裂、操纵面损坏，或影响电气、导航和通信系统，也可能引发电气火灾或造成人员受伤。损伤程度各不相同，因此机组遭遇雷击后应评估飞机状态并执行适用程序。

cards.audioText: What damage can lightning cause to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 闪电会给飞机带来什么损害？
cards.referenceText: First, lightning strike may cause damage to the aircraft such as fuselage, wings and electronic equipment. Second, lightning strike may cause communication and navigation failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，雷击可能会对飞机机身、机翼和电子设备等造成损坏。其次，雷击可能会导致通信和导航故障。

cards.audioText: In what weather conditions is lightning strike most likely to happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么天气条件下最有可能发生雷击？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strike is most likely to occur in thunderstorm or CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击最有可能发生在雷暴或CB中。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encounter lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你遇到雷击，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If we encounter lightning strike, I would report our situation to ATC and request a change of the course or route to avoid lightning strike. Then I would check if there is any damage on board If there is any damage to the aircraft, I would request priority or emergency handling and emergency services. If there is no damage to the aircraft, I would continue the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我们遇到雷击，我们将向ATC报告我们的情况，并要求改变航向/路线以避免雷击。然后我们将检查飞机上是否有任何损坏。如果飞机有任何损坏，我们将请求紧急降落和紧急服务。如果飞机没有损坏，我们将继续飞行。

cards.audioText: How can pilots reduce the danger of encountering lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何降低遭遇雷击的危险？
cards.referenceText: First, pilots can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into CB or thunderstorm. Second, if we encounter lightning strike during flight, I would change the route or course to avoid the lightning strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我们可以在飞行前和飞行中获取天气信息，以避免飞入CB或雷暴。其次，如果我们在飞行中遇到雷击，我们会改变路线/航向以避免雷击。

cards.audioText: What is your suggestion to reduce incidents caused by lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有什么建议来减少雷击事件？
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. First, pilots can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into CB or thunderstorm. Second, if we encounter lightning strike during flight, I would change the route or course to avoid the lightning strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。首先，我们可以在飞行前和飞行中获取天气信息，以避免飞入CB或雷暴。其次，如果我们在飞行中遇到雷击，我们会改变路线/航向以避免雷击。

cards.audioText: In which phase does lightning strike usually occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 通常在飞行的哪个时期可能会遭到雷击？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strike usually occurs during cruise phase (high altitude with CB or thunderstorms) and climb or descent phases when passing through convective clouds. Takeoff or landing phases are less likely but possible if the airport is in a thunderstorm area. It is more frequent in areas with strong atmospheric convection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击通常发生在巡航阶段（高空积雨云/雷暴区域）以及爬升/下降阶段（穿越对流云时）。起飞/着陆阶段可能性较低，但如果机场处于雷暴区域也可能发生，在大气对流强烈的区域更为频繁。
